turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: Indeed, Your Majesty. If you will now disclose the full details of your request, Mr. Holmes and I shall do our utmost to assist you.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: The matter is indeed delicate, but as you have correctly deduced my identity, I shall proceed with full disclosure. The issue at hand involves my estranged fiancée, Irene Adler, and a photograph that holds significant political and personal ramifications.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: I appreciate your candor, Your Majesty. The photograph you refer to is indeed a matter of both personal and political consequence. Please, elucidate the specifics.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: Irene Adler, a woman of such influence over you, Your Majesty. Please, continue with the details of your predicament.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: Irene Adler possesses a photograph that could jeopardize my standing as King and my future with her. I wish to reclaim it without resorting to scandal or violence, if at all possible.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: I see, Your Majesty. The delicacy of the situation is clear. Mr. Holmes, it seems we have a complex case on our hands.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: The photograph in question, I presume, is of a compromising nature. Let us discuss the details of its retrieval without delay.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: The photograph in question is indeed of a most compromising nature. I am at your mercy, Mr. Holmes, to devise a solution that preserves both my dignity and the stability of my kingdom.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: Certainly, Your Majesty. Mr. Holmes will approach this matter with the utmost discretion. Please, let us move to a more private area to discuss the specifics.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I am grateful for your understanding, Dr. Watson. Let us proceed with haste, for the stakes are far too high to delay.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: Very well, Your Majesty. Mr. Holmes and I will do everything in our power to assist you.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: Let us retire to the study, Your Majesty. There we can examine the photograph and formulate a plan that ensures your confidentiality.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: Indeed, Mr. Holmes. I trust your discretion and expertise implicitly. Let us hurry to the study.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: Agreed, Your Majesty. Dr. Watson, please precede us to the study and ensure the door is securely closed.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I shall follow, Mr. Holmes. My nerves are on edge, but your reputation precedes you, and I place my faith in your abilities.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: Very well, let us proceed without delay.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I must admit, Mr. Holmes, the weight of this matter is suffocating. I fear for the safety of my kingdom and my own reputation should this scandal come to light.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: Your Majesty, the sooner we address this issue, the sooner you may regain your peace of mind. Let us proceed with the utmost confidentiality.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: Of course, Holmes. Let us ensure our privacy is maintained.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: Let us retire to my private study, Your Majesty. There we shall discuss the particulars of your case.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: You had my note? I told you that I would call.

opening.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
opening.text: Pray take a seat. This is my friend and colleague, Dr. Watson, who is occasionally good enough to help me in my cases. Whom have I the honour to address?

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: You may address me as the Count Von Kramm, a Bohemian nobleman. I understand that this gentleman, your friend, is a man of honour and discretion, whom I may trust with a matter of the most extreme importance. If not, I should much prefer to communicate with you alone.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: Then I must begin. I must bind you both to absolute secrecy for two years; at the end of that time the matter will be of no importance. At present it is not too much to say that it is of such weight it may have an influence upon European history.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: You will excuse this mask. The august person who employs me wishes his agent to be unknown to you, and I may confess at once that the title by which I have just called myself is not exactly my own.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: The circumstances are of great delicacy, and every precaution has to be taken to quench what might grow to be an immense scandal and seriously compromise one of the reigning families of Europe. To speak plainly, the matter implicates the great House of Ormstein, hereditary kings of Bohemia.

opening.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
opening.text: I was also aware of that.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: If your Majesty would condescend to state your case, I should be better able to advise you.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: You are right. I am the King. Why should I attempt to conceal it?
